info.body_text:
Emilie got off from her clothes and was preparing herself.


"What should i do today?"
She looked at her body and figure. She was proud of her silhouette and felt good with her sensual shape.


She chose some of her sport gear and decided to :
Go to the Gym
or
Do Yoga
or
Go Running
